title: Kane and The Undertaker: the brother’s revenge
summary: Paul Bearer’s warnings become real when Kane arrives to confront The Undertaker. WWE’s fictional family history drives the brothers toward their first WrestleMania match.

chapters.title: Kane makes his entrance
chapters.result: Kane tears into Hell in a Cell and attacks The Undertaker.
chapters.context: Kane’s arrival costs Undertaker against Shawn Michaels.

chapters.title: The brothers finally fight
chapters.context: This is the first WrestleMania match between the storyline brothers.
